name: Paddle
description: Paddle Billing becomes events: Placed Order for each completed transaction, Refunded Order for each approved refund (its own amount), and Subscription Started and Cancelled. Customers who ticked Paddle Checkout's marketing box are subscribed to email; everyone else is held back from marketing.

signature_secret.label: Paddle endpoint secret key
signature_secret.help: Starts with pdl_ntfset_. Paddle → Developer tools → Notifications → your destination → Secret key.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.

In Paddle, go to Developer tools → Notifications → New destination. Choose Webhook, paste the webhook URL, and tick these events: transaction.completed, adjustment.created, adjustment.updated, subscription.created, subscription.activated, subscription.canceled, customer.created, customer.updated. Save.
Copy the destination's secret key (pdl_ntfset_…) and save it as the integration's signing secret.
Send a test notification (or use Paddle's webhook simulator) and check the delivery log. A transaction that arrives before its customer is tried again a few minutes later.
Only customers who tick Paddle Checkout's marketing consent box are subscribed to email. Everyone else is held back from marketing.
Review the draft win-back flow and turn it on.

flows.name: Paddle: subscription win-back
flows.description: Three days after a subscription is cancelled, asks what went wrong and invites them back. Marketing: only reaches subscribed people.
